note: From the OpenStreetMap export (the main API, 14 October 2026; tools/osm-to-kit.mjs and its railway=rail ways, platforms and stop positions) and the view from above (docs/reference/aerial/handforth.jpg), at real scale across the line like the tracks. Positive v is east (east-north-east). Two side platforms in a cutting, u -119 to 66, 1.68 m outside the Crewe line's two tracks (the line towards Manchester at v 0, the line towards Crewe at 3.52; the export's stop positions put them 0.1 and 3.1). The halt (trains towards Manchester) is the west platform, the export's platform 2; the east one, its platform 1, is the second platform. The halt is the platforms' north part and the extension the rest, so trains stop 26 m south of the station's point to stand in the middle. The B5358 Station Road crosses the north end on a bridge (u 81 to 89), and a footpath bridge crosses about 50 m beyond it (u 139, scenery). Photos (docs/reference/photos/handforth: ticket-office-1.jpg, roadbridge-1.jpg, roadbridge-2.jpg, platform-south-1.jpg and platform-train-1.jpg El Pollock 2015, overview-1.jpg JThomas 2024, platform-north-1.jpg Kevin Waterhouse 2025): the booking office is a single-storey green and white building on the road bridge's south side at street level, and stairs with green railings climb along the back of each platform to the road (the export's steps, u 53 to 66), so the way across is the road bridge, no footbridge: the crossing stage is those stairs. Shelters, lamps, boards, the canopy, the shops and the barriers placed by eye; the lifts are the game's (the photos show none). The cycle stands are the export's. The car park is the export's public one west of the line off Station Road (whether it serves the station is not known); the replacement bus stop on Station Road east of the bridge is placed by eye. Bridge sizes from the export and the photos, its height from memory.
